layer_description: These provisions sit between the basic enabling framework and the detailed operational rules. They delimit when the regime applies, allocate institutional roles, and channel later implementation through references to follow-on acts, consultation steps, reporting duties, or internal procedures.
repr_descriptions: ["Structural-to-operational delegation clause: it does not itself set the reporting mechanics, but assigns the Commission the task of fixing the modalities, structure, and periodicity through implementing acts. Its abstraction level is intermediate, because it organises how a later, more technical rule will be made and applied rather than laying down the concrete detail directly.", "Structural-to-operational provision: it does not lay down a general principle, but creates a conditional follow-up obligation for the Commission tied to prior reporting and assessment steps. Its abstraction level is intermediate because it sets a procedural trigger and a deadline for proposing later amendments, rather than fixing the substantive rules themselves.", "Structural-to-operational provision: it sets an implementation rule for how information must be made available, while preserving a higher-level constraint and cross-referencing an existing framework. The text then shifts into a delegation clause, which is structural because it organises who may exercise delegated power, but it remains below foundational level since it does not itself lay down the substantive content of that power.", "Structural to operational: it creates an institutional coordination rule and then directs a specific consultative step to be taken in a defined class of matters. Its abstraction level is intermediate because it does not lay down a general principle for the whole framework, but instead allocates a procedural obligation within a particular decision-making context.", "Structural to operational: this is a scope-and-implementation clause that translates higher-level legal requirements into the Commission’s internal rules for a defined procedural context. It does not state a general principle; instead, it specifies the concrete conditions and legal basis for how particular obligations and possible restrictions are to be applied.", "Structural provision that identifies the operative scope of the internal regime by linking it to the relevant legal exceptions and restrictions. It sits above purely technical detail because it does not itself set a procedure or threshold, but instead organizes when the later rules apply within the framework.", "Structural provision that introduces a core operational obligation within the instrument, sitting below the foundational level but above detailed implementation rules. It functions as an organising rule because it sets out the general duty in this part of the decision, without yet fixing the specific procedure, conditions, or technical mechanics for how that duty is carried out.", "Structural-to-operational provision establishing an internal review and documentation mechanism within the framework. It does not set a general principle or define the regime, but specifies who must be notified, what access may be granted, and how the review process is to be recorded in individual cases.", "Structural-to-operational provision: it sits below the basic enabling framework and above purely technical implementation, because it identifies the specific procedural areas covered by the act and signals that more detailed rules follow. Its function is to delimit scope and organise the regulatory architecture by pointing to the kinds of procedural arrangements to be specified, rather than laying down a self-contained operative rule.", "Structural provision that identifies the category of actors allowed to trigger the procedural mechanism, placing it above purely operational detail but below foundational principles. It is specific because it allocates standing within the framework rather than laying down a general rule or a technical procedure."]

layer_description: These provisions prescribe concrete administrative or evidentiary steps within an already established legal procedure. They do not create the underlying power, scope, or principle, but operationalize it through specific actions such as recording, transmitting, acknowledging, disclosing, or meeting deadlines.
repr_descriptions: ["Operational provision setting an internal compliance step for a specific case: when a restriction is applied, the reasons must be recorded and registered. It sits below structural rules because it does not establish the power to restrict or the general criteria for doing so, but instead prescribes a concrete administrative follow-up procedure.", "Operational provision setting a concrete administrative step within an already established restriction procedure. It is specific because it requires the recording and registration of reasons, implementing the broader rule through a precise compliance action rather than laying down a general principle.", "Operational provision that organizes how a restriction measure is documented and entered into the relevant records. It sits below the structural level because it does not establish the power or principle itself, but specifies the administrative step needed to implement it in practice.", "Operational provision setting a concrete procedural obligation for the institution to document and justify each restriction, including the required proportionality assessment. It sits below the structural level because it does not establish the framework or powers themselves, but specifies how an already available restriction must be applied in practice.", "Operational provision setting a concrete evidentiary/content requirement for the internal record when a restriction is applied. It sits below the structural level because it does not establish the power or principle itself, but specifies the precise justification that must be documented in a particular case.", "Operational provision setting a concrete administrative step within an already established procedure. It is specific because it prescribes an immediate written acknowledgment of receipt in a defined procedural situation, rather than laying down a general principle or delegating further rule-making power.", "Operational provision specifying a concrete transmission step within an already established procedure — it sits below the structural level because it does not create the framework, but tells a particular actor how a required filing is to be passed on. Its specificity comes from fixing the addressee, the object to be transferred, and the reference to compliance with another article, making it a narrow implementation rule rather than a general principle.", "Operational provision setting a concrete procedural deadline within an ongoing proceeding, so it sits near the technical end of the hierarchy. Its defining feature is that it fixes a time limit for a specific step in the process, rather than establishing a general principle or allocating powers.", "Operational provision setting a concrete post-inspection disclosure step within a specific procedure, so it sits near the technical end of the hierarchy. Its abstraction level is low because it does not establish a general principle or allocate powers, but instead prescribes a narrow procedural consequence triggered by a prior action.", "Operational provision setting a concrete procedural obligation for a party in the course of a specific proceeding. It sits below structural rules because it does not establish the framework itself, but instead prescribes a detailed step for how supporting materials must be submitted and handled."]

layer_description: These segments are narrowly operative rules that translate a broader framework into concrete, case-specific steps, deadlines, evidentiary requirements, and triggering conditions. They do not establish general principles or allocate high-level powers; instead, they implement and refine the application of the instrument through detailed procedural rules.
repr_descriptions: ["Highly operational, bordering on technical: this is a definitions clause that fixes the meaning of key terms for use throughout the instrument. It does not lay down a general principle or allocate powers; instead, it supplies interpretive building blocks that support the application of more specific procedural rules.", "Highly specific operational clause within a procedural framework, because it identifies one concrete implementation scenario tied to a prior decision and cross-refers to particular enabling provisions. It functions as a technical sub-rule rather than a general principle, since it narrows the rule to a defined procedural step in a particular case.", "Highly technical operational clause that specifies a concrete evidentiary requirement within a broader procedural mechanism. It sits near the bottom of the abstraction spectrum because it does not set a general principle or allocate powers, but instead fixes a narrow condition for how a party must support a confidentiality claim for particular materials.", "Highly technical operational clause that identifies a specific category of external advisers by cross-reference to an earlier paragraph. It sits near the bottom of the hierarchy because it does not set a general principle or procedure, but merely refines who may fall within an already established mechanism.", "Highly technical operative clause that functions as a cross-reference and conditional gateway within a larger procedure. It sits near the most specific end of the hierarchy because it does not lay down a general rule or principle, but instead identifies the exact legal bases and triggering grounds for a particular procedural step.", "Highly technical operational clause that fixes a specific temporal rule for a procedural pause and its end point. It sits at the narrow end of the spectrum because it does not state a general principle or allocate powers, but instead specifies the exact period to be counted in a particular information-gathering situation.", "Highly technical operational clause that fixes the temporal endpoint for a specific information-related obligation. It sits near the most concrete end of the hierarchy because it does not establish a general principle or framework, but instead specifies a precise calculation rule for a narrowly defined procedural situation.", "Technical operative rule within a procedural framework, sitting at the most specific end of the spectrum. It fixes a concrete legal consequence for electronically transmitted documents by defining when receipt is not recognized, thereby regulating a narrow procedural condition rather than setting any general principle.", "Technical-operational clause, near the bottom of the hierarchy. It fixes a concrete notification obligation and a specific deadline, so it implements the framework through a precise procedural requirement rather than laying down a general principle or structural rule.", "Technical definitional criterion within a broader screening framework, sitting toward the operational end of the hierarchy. It specifies a concrete category of assets by listing illustrative subtypes and examples, which makes it a narrow rule used to apply a wider assessment rather than a foundational principle."]

layer_description: These provisions sit at the technical, operational end of the hierarchy and do not establish broad principles or core competences. Instead, they regulate how an existing rule is applied in конкретe cases through triggers, exceptions, extensions, waivers, time limits, and procedural consequences.
repr_descriptions: ["Operational clause governing the post-adoption handling of a delegated act, so it sits near the technical end of the spectrum. Its function is procedural rather than substantive: it specifies a concrete notification step that must occur immediately after a delegated act is adopted, without setting any broader principle or policy rule.", "Operational clause governing the entry into force of a delegated act, so it sits near the technical end of the hierarchy. It does not set a general principle or allocate broad competences; instead, it fixes a specific approval-and-objection procedure with a precise time limit and extension mechanism.", "Operational scope clause that delimits the decision’s field of application by tying it to a defined set of Commission activities. It sits below structural provisions because it does not create a general principle or power; it simply specifies when the internal rules become applicable in practice.", "Operational restriction clause that sets a concrete condition for when a limitation may be applied, rather than stating a general principle. It sits near the technical end of the spectrum because it identifies a specific jeopardy-based trigger within a broader decision-making framework.", "Operational balancing clause that carves out a specific exception from an otherwise applicable rule by setting a conditional override test. It sits toward the technical end of the spectrum because it does not establish a general principle or framework, but instead specifies when a particular limitation does not apply.", "Operational clause providing a specific procedural route for exercising a right when a restriction applies, rather than laying down a general principle. It sits near the technical end of the spectrum because it activates only in a defined contingency and cross-refers to an external procedure for how the right is to be exercised.", "Operational continuation clause that governs the duration of previously imposed restrictions. It sits near the technical end of the spectrum because it does not create the restriction itself or set a general principle, but only specifies when the existing measure must keep applying.", "Operational clause granting a discretionary waiver from a filing obligation in a defined procedural setting — it sits below structural provisions because it regulates how an existing process may be relaxed in individual cases. Its specificity comes from the conditional trigger, the identified decision-maker, and the precise procedural effect on the information requirements.", "Operational clause granting a discretionary extension power in exceptional circumstances — it sits below structural provisions because it does not set the framework itself, but adjusts the application of an existing procedural limit. Its abstraction level is relatively specific, since it turns on a defined condition and authorises a case-by-case deviation rather than laying down a general principle.", "Operational clause with a narrow discretionary exception: it allows the Commission to depart from the ordinary deadline rule in exceptional circumstances. Its abstraction level is low because it does not set a general principle or framework, but instead specifies a conditional procedural choice and the factor to be weighed when exercising that discretion."]

layer_description: These provisions sit at the lowest, most concrete level of the hierarchy: they specify exact procedural steps, deadlines, evidentiary forms, exemptions, and conditional consequences for narrowly defined situations. Rather than laying down general principles or allocating powers, they fine-tune how an existing regime works in practice.
repr_descriptions: ["Highly operational and technical: it sets a conditional exception tied to a very specific source of data and a defined legal basis for restriction. Its function is not to establish a general principle, but to carve out a narrow applicability rule within a larger procedural framework.", "Highly operational and technical: this is a narrow informational sub-rule within a larger restriction procedure. It specifies one concrete element that must be communicated, rather than setting a general principle or allocating powers.", "Highly operational and technical: it lists specific implementing sub-rules and procedural details within a pre-existing framework rather than laying down any general principle. Its function is to fix concrete modalities, time limits, disclosure arrangements, and formal requirements, which places it near the most specific end of the hierarchy.", "Highly operational, with a technical sub-rule character: it sets a specific filing alternative and a precise reporting exemption triggered by defined conditions. Its abstraction level is low because it does not establish a general principle or institutional structure, but instead prescribes the exact procedural form and threshold-based detail for one narrowly defined situation.", "Highly operational and technical: it sets a conditional consequence for a very specific procedural situation, triggered only if a particular clarification request is made and not properly answered. Its function is to fix the legal effect of that narrow scenario, rather than to state a general principle or organise the framework at a higher level.", "Highly operational and technical: it supplies a narrow evidentiary/formal rule for how a specific explanation may be recorded. Its place is at the lowest end of abstraction because it does not set a general principle or allocate powers, but merely specifies an acceptable form of documentation in a particular procedural context.", "Highly operational and technical: it lays down a specific procedural safeguard triggered by a narrow factual situation, rather than a general principle. Its abstraction level is low because it prescribes a concrete time-limit mechanism and a documentation consequence for a particular kind of explanation already given.", "Highly technical operational rule fixing a concrete filing deadline within a specific procedural step. It sits near the bottom of the abstraction spectrum because it does not establish a general principle or allocate powers, but instead specifies an exact time limit triggered by a defined procedural event.", "Highly specific operational rule that adjusts a procedural deadline in a contingent situation. It sits near the technical end of the spectrum because it does not establish a general principle or framework, but instead fixes an automatic consequence triggered by a prior extension and ties one time limit to another.", "Highly operational, bordering on technical: it sets a concrete conditional step triggered by a waiver and prescribes exactly what must be identified and justified. Its abstraction level is low because it does not establish a general principle or institutional power, but instead fixes a specific procedural requirement for a particular situation."]
